Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Engine fuel supply

  • Device: Injector

  • Fault: Significant difficulty starting when the engine is warm; once started, the vehicle runs smoothly.

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: - -

  • Cause: Faulty injector on the third cylinder

• Action: Check the condition and correct operation of the injectors; if necessary, overhaul or replace any that are malfunctioning or defective.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: In this case, the 3rd injector from the timing side exhibited a slightly higher fuel return during the start-up attempt.
    Diagnostic equipment also revealed that the measured fuel pressure was significantly lower than the target value.
    Following the replacement of the third cylinder’s injector, the problem was definitively resolved.
